key_provisions_or_claims: Sets six strategic priorities for 2026-2030, including literacy/maths/science, digital skills and citizenship education, lifelong learning, teaching profession, VET and higher education.
Agrees nine EU-level targets for 2030, e.g. under 15% low achievers and 47% tertiary attainment.
Keeps existing governance structure (High Level Group, open method of coordination, peer learning).
Calls for AI literacy and ethical, responsible use of AI in education and teacher training.
Invites Member States and Commission to cooperate with respect for subsidiarity.
annotation.summary_en: Council Resolution setting the second cycle (2026-2030) of the EU strategic framework for education and training towards the European Education Area. It defines six priorities, nine EU-level targets and governance via voluntary cooperation. AI appears only as a digital skills and ethical-use theme in education.
